retained_principal_claims.claim: The bounded native route exposes six separately checkable gates: source admission, observation availability, value/codomain conformance, source-evidence adequacy, policy interpretation and consumer admission/source replay.
retained_principal_claims.falsifier: A declared route state that cannot be assigned to one gate without overlap or omission, or code that silently bypasses a gate.
retained_principal_claims.scope: Bounded Python/Markdown/text route and declared consumer; no statement about static analysis in general.

retained_principal_claims.claim: Passing one named gate does not substitute for passing selected other gates: the supplied bounded witnesses refute five specified implications.
retained_principal_claims.falsifier: Any named witness fails its predecessor gate, does not fail its target gate, or depends on an undeclared domain shift.
retained_principal_claims.scope: Five specified failed implications only; no statistical independence or all-pairs logical independence.

retained_principal_claims.claim: The four-state applicability contract distinguishes observed zero from not_applicable, insufficient_evidence and unavailable.
retained_principal_claims.evidence: src/codeprobe_measurement_kernel.py applicability validator; P6-T06; candidate schema validation
retained_principal_claims.falsifier: A non-observed record with a non-null value, an observed record with null, or an observed zero coerced to an unavailable state.
retained_principal_claims.scope: Records admitted by the candidate measurement-kernel contract.

retained_principal_claims.claim: For the monotone predicate x>t over an integer threshold interval [L,U], the endpoint outcomes determine the three-state projection: no_rule_trigger, abstain or review_opportunity.
retained_principal_claims.evidence: General proof in FormalBoundarySpecification v2; independent exhaustive comparison over 3,948 cases in P6-T01 and P3-T01
retained_principal_claims.falsifier: One admissible integer tuple (L,U,nominal,x) for which the full interval and endpoint projection differ.
retained_principal_claims.scope: Monotone predicate x>t and declared integer domain only.

retained_principal_claims.claim: Callable decision counts, offset complexity and nesting follow finite AST conventions, and traversal evidence must cover every visited source span in the generated diagnostic domain.
retained_principal_claims.evidence: P3-T02/P3-T03/P3-T04/P3-T14 PASS; candidate source retains traversal algorithm and evidence cover
retained_principal_claims.falsifier: A generated admitted callable for which the independent recursive walker disagrees, or a visited span lies outside admitted traversal evidence.
retained_principal_claims.scope: CPython AST representation and declared finite visitor; not universal CFG complexity.

retained_principal_claims.claim: The candidate separates stable observation-slot identity from deterministic result-content identity: record_id binds specification plus logical entity, while measurement_digest binds artifact, evidence and observation content.
retained_principal_claims.falsifier: Evidence-only content changes alter record_id, content changes preserve measurement_digest, or a specification-version change preserves the affected record_id.
retained_principal_claims.scope: record_id is stable only within a declared measurement-result scope and is not globally unique.

retained_principal_claims.claim: Structural validity and internal digest consistency are insufficient for coordinate adequacy or source replay; later gates may reject a self-consistent record.

retained_principal_claims.falsifier: The target gate accepts every named adversarial record or the earlier gate did not actually pass.
retained_principal_claims.scope: Named generated adversarial records; no prevalence claim.

retained_principal_claims.claim: The candidate declares decision-point count as ratio, offset McCabe-style C=1+d as ordinal, exact decimal comparison with an inclusive boundary and conservative binary64 boundary diagnosis.
retained_principal_claims.falsifier: A ratio interpretation of C remains in the candidate contract, exact decimal boundary evaluation is nondeterministic, or an indeterminate binary boundary is admitted as a pass.
retained_principal_claims.scope: Prospective local candidate only; no reinterpretation of historical CE09/CE11 outputs.

retained_principal_claims.claim: The retained evidence establishes bounded existence and contract behaviour, without estimating natural-project prevalence, human benefit, economic effect, universal correctness or independent replication.
